acceptanceCriteria: A batch with an unnamed obligation, or a mixed test.fail test, is refused before any lane is acquired, with file:line.
Clean tickets pass with no false positives on contract-annotated obligations.
Spec requirements recorded and owner-accepted; focused tests trace them; #713 answered on the merged PR.
body: GitHub beamfall/corvint#713. Add corvint-tasks preflight <ticket> [--commit OID] [--deep] reading specs from the commit via git: every batch obligation named in a test title/test.step (contract-annotated <contract>:<witness> counts as named); flag test.fail tests naming non-expected-fail obligations with file:line; run the obligation-ledger consolidation and plan checks; --deep runs configured lint/contract commands in a clean worktree. Returns PREFLIGHT_FAILED with each problem and remedy; pool acquire for a test batch can require a passing preflight for the same tree.
title: GH #713: corvint-tasks preflight refuses test batches that cannot pass before lane acquisition
